speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
text: Places are allocated on a first come, first served basis for fairness and transparency.

speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
text: MUIS and the Ministry of Health have worked with local healthcare providers to help our pilgrims fulfil these requirements.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: I had constituents meet with me to ask more about the support that can be given to them for their Haj trips and especially those of their senior parents, particularly in the safety and health aspects when they are at Haj.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: I hope that the Minister could provide us with some examples of how MUIS, as well as the Ministry, is assisting them on this and supporting them through this.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: And I am also heartened that there are workings right now to ask for a higher quota.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
text: But could I ask: is there anymore that we can do to improve our chances of obtaining a higher quota for Haj?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: It is an important area for the Muslim community here in Singapore.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: While I had conveyed this request, as shared in my answer, during my recent meeting with the Saudi Arabia's Minister of Hajj and Umrah, other Singapore leaders have also raised the same request during their meetings with the Saudi Arabia counterparts.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, I assure the Member we will continue to do so.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: At the same time, MUIS works closely with the Saudi Arabia Ministry of Hajj and Umrah in demonstrating excellent Haj management and also compliance with regulation.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, this I believe will put us in good stead to request for larger Haj quota.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, I would like to urge everyone here, as well as whoever can contribute in this, let us continue to work together to help our Muslim community fulfil their aspirations to perform the Haj.
